module_title: Boilermaker Tools, Equipment, Machines and Materials
title: Materials Used in Fabrication: Properties, Identification and Defects
objective: Recognise that fabrication materials have different properties, identification requirements and possible defects.

sections.heading: 1. Material properties
sections.body: Materials differ in properties that affect their suitability for particular fabrication requirements.

sections.heading: 2. Identification
sections.body: Material grades, markings, documentation and job specifications help establish material identity.

sections.heading: 3. Defects
sections.body: Visible damage, deterioration or uncertainty about material identity can affect quality and must be addressed.

sections.heading: 4. Traceability
sections.body: Material records support verification that the intended material is connected to the required job.

questions.question: Do all fabrication materials have identical properties?
